verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with a CLI, SDKs and AI-assistance features, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the Firebase CLI, SDKs, MCP server or Gemini in Firebase. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
